notes: Read DHMI AIP Turkey AD 2 LTAI (English PDF): AD 2.3 page AIRAC AMDT 03/26 (19 Mar 2026), AD 2.4 and AD 2.12 AMDT 02/26 (19 Feb 2026), AD 2.20 pages AMDT 11/25 to 08/26 (6 Aug 2026).
